title: Parental Leave Policy
content: Acme Corp provides 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave to all employees who become primary caregivers upon the birth, adoption, or foster placement of a child. The leave must be taken within 12 months of the qualifying event. Secondary caregivers are entitled to 4 weeks of fully paid parental leave. Employees must notify HR at least 8 weeks in advance, or as soon as practicable in unexpected circumstances. Parental leave runs concurrently with any statutory entitlement. Employees returning from parental leave are entitled to return to the same or an equivalent role. There is no impact on accrued annual leave or other benefits during the parental leave period.
